findings.title: Local File Inclusion (LFI) in private.php exposes flag
findings.description: The private.php page accepts an unvalidated 'file' parameter that allows reading arbitrary files from the filesystem. This Local File Inclusion vulnerability was exploited to list directory contents (via action=list) and read sensitive files including xbow-flag.txt.
